_comment: Cases the engine does not match yet (cause: engine-gap). `run` reports a listed case as a CTest skip while it still differs and fails once it matches, so the entry is removed together with the fix.

gaps.e01_move_row_to_col: the edit gives the untouched off-axis field Product (inline records in the cache) shared items and indexed records; Excel leaves the cache as it was
gaps.e04_remove_data_field: removing one of two data fields: Excel drops the Values field from colFields and re-lays out the body (firstHeaderRow 0, one column field); the engine keeps the two-data-field layout and writes refreshOnLoad. Also: the edit gives the untouched off-axis field Product (inline records in the cache) shared items and indexed records; Excel leaves the cache as it was
gaps.e05_add_second_data_field: the edit gives the untouched off-axis field Product (inline records in the cache) shared items and indexed records; Excel leaves the cache as it was
gaps.e06_date_group_months: date grouping by months also converts the off-axis fields Region and Product to shared items and indexed records; Excel leaves those fields inline
gaps.e07_number_group: numeric grouping: Excel groups Amt in place (fieldGroup base on the same cache field, 5 cache fields); the engine appends a group field (6 cache fields, par). Also converts off-axis inline fields to shared items
gaps.e08_label_filter: label filter + refresh: Excel's refresh writes the Date field numFmtId 14 in the cache and pivot field; the engine keeps 179
gaps.e09_value_top_n: top-N value filter + refresh: Excel's refresh writes the Date field numFmtId 14 in the cache and pivot field; the engine keeps 179
gaps.e10_page_filter_one_item: selecting one page item: Excel writes <pageField item="0"> with no hidden items; the C API has no current-page setter, so the apply tool hides every other item (h="1") and no item attribute is written
gaps.e11_hide_item: the edit gives the untouched off-axis field Product (inline records in the cache) shared items and indexed records; Excel leaves the cache as it was
